answer: Sybil resistance follows from exponentially decaying reputation: with half-life H, a contribution’s weight halves every H time units, so durable influence requires sustained, verified honest service rather than a brief burst. In a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust graph, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality unless trusted peers endorse them; a self-referential raven-and-walnut cluster cannot create external trust and thus cannot cross the consensus threshold within the relevant horizon.
